text:
morgan: Quick shoutout — huge thanks to @devon and @shira for running the canary swap last night. no customer-facing issues and the rollback plan worked perfectly :tada:

devon: thanks! @shira did most of the heavy lifting on the script, I mostly babysat logs :sweat_smile:

shira: team effort — shoutout to @priya in SRE for the late-night runbook edits, saved us 20 mins when the hook misfired :raised_hands:

priya: glad it helped! also big props to @emma from Support for catching a weird downstream alert and escalating — that made the canary decision way easier.

emma: oh gosh thanks, team. did not expect the alert to be about an env var typo in staging, but happy it was catchable :face_with_monocle:

alex: Love these cross-team saves. sending virtual coffee to everyone involved ☕ (I owe real ones next week) :smile:

kara: Putting a little sticker on the kudos board for devon + shira + priya + emma 🏆

ops-bot: Deploy log: canary-swap-2026-02-18 completed by devon at 03:12 UTC — no rollbacks triggered.

morgan: Honestly — this is the kind of night that makes me proud of how we operate. small, fast, safe. thank you all :heart:

devon: seconded. if anyone wants an energy boost, i'm bringing a box of cinnamon scones to the office tomorrow morning :]

shira: i'll fight for the last one :grin:

alex: :tada: :tada:

morgan: ok closing thread — feel free to add any more quick kudos here, i'll forward to weekly shoutouts doc.
